label: class_a_04_ecology_01
text: Hello, hello, everyone. Today is our\nmidterm exam.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_04_ecology_02
text: It sure feels good to fill in all those empty spaces\non the answer sheet, doesn’t it?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_04_ecology_03
text: Take your time, and contemplate each\nquestion carefully.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_04_question_01
text:
1. What button would you use to let a Pokémon
    out of its ball so that it can walk with you?

A) R Button
B) ZR Button
C) + Button

label: class_a_04_question_02
text:
2. Combine one letter and one number below to
    correctly say when and where Eggs are found.

A) During picnics	1) In tall grass
B) While walking	2) In your basket

label: class_a_04_question_03
text:
3. Which of the following is an effective way to
    warm up Eggs?

A) Going to sleep
B) Walking around
C) Battling

label: class_a_04_question_04
text:
4. What will NOT make Pokémon easier to catch?

A) Giving them a Berry
B) Surprising them from behind
C) Inflicting them with poison
D) Using certain kinds of Poké Balls

label: class_a_04_ansewer_04c_00
text: D) Using certain kinds of Poké Balls

label: class_a_04_question_05
text:
5. What will make it easier to catch Pokémon of
    higher and higher levels?

A) Certifications
B) LP
C) Gym Badges

label: class_a_04_question_06
text:
—This question won’t affect your grade!—

How do you like the Pokédex? Is it easy to use?
I’d be happy to hear your honest opinions!

label: class_a_04_ansewer_06c
text: I don’t use it that much...

label: class_a_04_ecology_04
text: All right, everyone! Time’s up! I hope you all\nenjoyed tackling those questions![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: class_a_04_ecology_05
text: That last question was just something that I’m\npersonally curious to know.\c\nDon’t tell the director about it, OK?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

text: I’ll grade these right away. I hope you’re all\nlooking forward to seeing how you did![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
